input_file.description: Path to the RPM file to process. Use '-' to read from standard input.

output_mode.description: How to handle the output. 'stdout' streams the cpio archive. 'directory' implies extraction via cpio.

extraction_dir.description: The directory where files are extracted if output_mode is 'directory'. Created if it does not exist.

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose listing during extraction (piped to cpio).
